Partition the 8 students into 4 unordered pairs. Pick the partner for the first student, then the next unpaired student, and so on:

- Student 1 can pair with any of the other 7 students: 7 choices.
- The lowest-numbered remaining student can pair with any of the remaining 5: 5 choices.
- Then 3 choices, then 1.

This gives 7 × 5 × 3 × 1 = 105.

Check with the formula: 8! / (2⁴ · 4!) = 40320 / (16 · 24) = 40320 / 384 = 105.

ANSWER: 105
